column1: # The command runs with CWD = exp/logs/<tag>/<name>/<config>/ (where gpgpusim.config is),
# so use absolute paths for the binary and its inputs. {exp} expands to this exp/ directory.
# Binaries are built by ~/chiplets/benchmarks/build.sh (sizes match paper Table 2).
# Graph / SDK workloads (paper Table 2 refs [22] [24] [75]); see benchmarks/build.sh
# GEMM (CUDA samples matrixMul, block 32): C(MxN) = A(MxK) * B(KxN) -> -hA=M -wA=K -hB=K -wB=N
# GPT3: Table 2 says N=5000, but its 2.31GB footprint matches N=50000 (GPT-3 vocab ~50K)
# CLAP Fig. 20: GEMM 8192x768x1024, then a second GEMM reads the top-left quarter of C* (CLAP + migration)
